# FLIPZ — Cartes Mystères

> Daily mystery card collection game. Open free packs every 12 hours, build your legendary collection, trade duplicates, and climb the winstreak.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Daily mystery card reveal with a 12-hour timer.
- [Collection](/collection): Browse your owned cards by rarity.
- [Packs](/packs): Open free and premium card packs.
- [Shop](/shop): Buy packs, trade duplicates, and redeem promo codes.
- [Profile](/profile): Player stats, winstreak, and account settings.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in.
